Ăgōnālis , e, adj.,
I.pertaining to the Agonalia (cf. preced. art.): dies Agonales, per quos rex in regiā arietem immolat; “dicti ab Agone (the leader, the chief), eo quod interrogatur a principe civitatis et princeps gregis immolatur,” Varr. L. L. 6, § 12 Müll.: “Janus Agonali luce piandus erit,” Ov. F. 1, 318 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
